question: NITI Aayog has released the first School Education Quality Index in _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2019**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **NITI Aayog** released the **first School Education Quality Index (SEQI)** in **2019**. The SEQI was developed to evaluate the performance of states and union territories in the field of **school education**.
 
• The index was prepared in collaboration with the **Ministry of Education** and the World Bank and aims to bring focus on the quality of education across different states.
 
• It uses a set of **30 indicators** categorized under domains like learning outcomes, access, equity, infrastructure, and governance processes to assess the performance of states and UTs.
 
• The SEQI was developed to encourage **states and union territories** to improve their school education systems by identifying strengths and weaknesses through objective data and ranking.
 
• The states and UTs were divided into **large states, small states, and union territories** to ensure fair comparisons, given their varied population sizes and resources.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **NITI Aayog:**

 
 
• NITI Aayog, established in **2015**, is a **policy think tank** of the Government of India aimed at fostering cooperative federalism.
 
• Its objective is to provide strategic and technical advice to states and union territories for effective governance.
 
 
 
• **School Education Quality Index (SEQI):**
 
 
• The SEQI provides an annual ranking of states and UTs based on their performance in the school education sector.
 
• The index encourages **competition** among states and UTs to improve their education systems.
 
• The ranking system is based on measurable indicators, ensuring **objectivity** in assessing performance.
 
 
 
• **Key Features of SEQI:**
 
 
• Focuses on **learning outcomes**, such as literacy and numeracy levels among students.
 
• Measures **equity** by considering the performance of marginalized groups and gender disparities.
 
• Evaluates **governance processes**, including teacher availability, student attendance, and management practices.
 
 
 
• **Performance Highlights:**
 
 
• Kerala was ranked as the **top-performing state** among large states in the first SEQI report.
 
• States like Uttar Pradesh and Bihar featured among the **lower-performing states**, highlighting the need for improvement.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Objective:** The index aims to improve **policy-making** in the education sector by providing data-driven insights into state-level performance.
 
• **Indicators:** SEQI includes indicators such as **student learning levels, dropout rates, gender parity, and infrastructure.**
 
• **Collaboration:** The index was developed with inputs from **international agencies** like the World Bank to ensure global standards in evaluation.
 
• **Significance:** SEQI serves as a tool for transparency and accountability in the education sector, encouraging states to focus on improving **quality** rather than just expanding access.
